subject: Proposed eval onramp & owner roles — next steps
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Mills <aaron.mills@nimbushealth.com>, Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap of today’s discovery + proposed next steps

Hi Aaron & Leah,

Thanks again for a great conversation today — appreciate the clear outline of your primary goals for an evaluation. Quick recap from our side:

- Objective: Validate automated chart summarization for ambulatory visit notes with less than 5% clinically relevant omission vs. your current extractors.
- Success metrics: 1) Precision on diagnosis extraction >= 92%, 2) Average latency < 350ms per API request at p95, 3) Prompt-set-driven regression tests for common failure modes.
- Constraints: PHI in-flight must remain within VPC/on-prem network for the trial; SOC2 evidence will be required.

Proposed immediate next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff (60–90m) that combines a technical deep dive + trial plan review. Suggested attendees:
- From Nimbus: Aaron (technical sponsor), Leah (product owner), 1 infra/security lead (TBD)
- From Redwood: me (AE), Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer), Karthik Iyer (Security/PM)

I’m proposing three time windows (all PT):
1) Tue 22 Aug — 10:00–11:30
2) Wed 23 Aug — 14:00–15:30
3) Thu 24 Aug — 09:00–10:30

Attached is a lightweight trial charter and a sample prompt pack to help you validate scope before the call. If none of the windows work, tell me two options that do and we’ll land on one.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Rachel

Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[rachel.kim@redwood.ai] | (415) 555-0172

Rachel — thanks for the quick recap and the docs, this is helpful. Leah and I reviewed the charter and we like the proposed structure. A couple of notes:

- Security: Our security lead (Tom Becker) needs to join the kickoff to confirm VPC/NAT constraints and KMS flow. He is only available mornings PT.
- Time windows: Tue 22 Aug is tight for us. Best slots for the Nimbus team are Thu 24 Aug 09:00–10:30 PT or Fri 25 Aug 08:30–10:00 PT.
- Prework: We’ll send a short list of 6 sample notes for your SE to sanity-check against the prompt pack before the call.

Can Ben & Karthik make the Thu 24 Aug 09:00–10:30 PT slot? If so, please calendar and send an agenda/drive link.

Thanks,
Aaron

- Karthik — can you cover SOC2 evidence and KMS integration during the kickoff?
